dashboard.description: Can renters rent on Lium: rentals created and deploys that failed, per cause and per node, from live rentals.

options.content: **Can renters rent on Lium?** Rentals created by renters, and the deploys that failed on a node, from each deploy's failure report. A failure caused by the renter (an image that exits at start or does not build, a pod deleted while starting) is counted apart from the node's. Node ids are cut to their first 8 characters. Until 3 Mar 2026 this page showed the per-node admin rental check, which was retired on 4 Mar 2026; its feed has no newer rows. Data refreshes about every 30 minutes.

panels.description: Every rental a renter created, including those whose deploy failed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Rentals" FROM rental_history r WHERE r.rental_start_time > now() - interval '1 day' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental_history c WHERE c.executor_id = r.executor_id AND c.rental_end_time = r.rental_start_time)

panels.title: Rentals created, last 24 h

panels.description: Failure reports for a deploy, without those caused by the renter's image or a delete while starting. A deploy can fail on one node and then run on another.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Failures" FROM (SELECT event_time, executor_id, CASE
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%default command exiting right after start%' THEN 'renter: image exits at start'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%docker_build%' OR details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%build_timeout%' THEN 'renter: image build'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%cancelled_by_delete%' THEN 'renter: deleted while starting'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%no executor accepted the SSH key%' OR details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%submit SSH key%' THEN 'node: SSH key rejected'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%Invalid executor id%' OR details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%offline%' THEN 'node: offline'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%Executor unreachable%' THEN 'node: unreachable'
    WHEN substring(details ->> 'error_message' from 'failure_step: ([a-z_]+)') IS NOT NULL THEN 'node: ' || substring(details ->> 'error_message' from 'failure_step: ([a-z_]+)')
    ELSE 'node: other'
  END AS cause
  FROM executor_events WHERE event_type = 'deploy_failed' AND event_time > now() - interval '1 day') f
WHERE cause NOT LIKE 'renter:%'

panels.title: Deploys failed on the node's side, last 24 h

panels.description: The two numbers to the left, as a rate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round((100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT event_time, executor_id, CASE
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%default command exiting right after start%' THEN 'renter: image exits at start'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%docker_build%' OR details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%build_timeout%' THEN 'renter: image build'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%cancelled_by_delete%' THEN 'renter: deleted while starting'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%no executor accepted the SSH key%' OR details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%submit SSH key%' THEN 'node: SSH key rejected'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%Invalid executor id%' OR details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%offline%' THEN 'node: offline'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%Executor unreachable%' THEN 'node: unreachable'
    WHEN substring(details ->> 'error_message' from 'failure_step: ([a-z_]+)') IS NOT NULL THEN 'node: ' || substring(details ->> 'error_message' from 'failure_step: ([a-z_]+)')
    ELSE 'node: other'
  END AS cause
  FROM executor_events WHERE event_type = 'deploy_failed' AND event_time > now() - interval '1 day') f WHERE cause NOT LIKE 'renter:%')
  / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM rental_history r WHERE r.rental_start_time > now() - interval '1 day' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental_history c WHERE c.executor_id = r.executor_id AND c.rental_end_time = r.rental_start_time)), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Per 100 rentals"

panels.title: Node-side failures per 100 rentals, last 24 h

panels.description: Per bucket of the picked range (hourly up to 30 days).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket(make_interval(secs => $__interval_ms / 1000.0), r.rental_start_time) AS time, count(*) AS "Rentals created"
FROM rental_history r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.rental_start_time) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental_history c WHERE c.executor_id = r.executor_id AND c.rental_end_time = r.rental_start_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket(make_interval(secs => $__interval_ms / 1000.0), event_time) AS time, count(*) AS "Node-side deploy failures"
FROM (SELECT event_time, executor_id, CASE
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%default command exiting right after start%' THEN 'renter: image exits at start'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%docker_build%' OR details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%build_timeout%' THEN 'renter: image build'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%cancelled_by_delete%' THEN 'renter: deleted while starting'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%no executor accepted the SSH key%' OR details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%submit SSH key%' THEN 'node: SSH key rejected'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%Invalid executor id%' OR details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%offline%' THEN 'node: offline'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%Executor unreachable%' THEN 'node: unreachable'
    WHEN substring(details ->> 'error_message' from 'failure_step: ([a-z_]+)') IS NOT NULL THEN 'node: ' || substring(details ->> 'error_message' from 'failure_step: ([a-z_]+)')
    ELSE 'node: other'
  END AS cause
  FROM executor_events WHERE event_type = 'deploy_failed' AND $__timeFilter(event_time)) f
WHERE cause NOT LIKE 'renter:%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rentals created and node-side deploy failures

panels.description: 'node:' is the step of the node's deploy that failed; 'renter:' is caused by the renter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', event_time) AS time, cause, count(*) AS n
FROM (SELECT event_time, executor_id, CASE
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%default command exiting right after start%' THEN 'renter: image exits at start'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%docker_build%' OR details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%build_timeout%' THEN 'renter: image build'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%cancelled_by_delete%' THEN 'renter: deleted while starting'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%no executor accepted the SSH key%' OR details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%submit SSH key%' THEN 'node: SSH key rejected'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%Invalid executor id%' OR details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%offline%' THEN 'node: offline'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%Executor unreachable%' THEN 'node: unreachable'
    WHEN substring(details ->> 'error_message' from 'failure_step: ([a-z_]+)') IS NOT NULL THEN 'node: ' || substring(details ->> 'error_message' from 'failure_step: ([a-z_]+)')
    ELSE 'node: other'
  END AS cause
  FROM executor_events WHERE event_type = 'deploy_failed' AND $__timeFilter(event_time)) f GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Deploy failures per day, by cause

panels.description: Find your node by the first 8 characters of its id. Renter-side failures are not the node's fault.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT left(executor_id, 8) AS "Node",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE cause NOT LIKE 'renter:%') AS "Node-side failures",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE cause LIKE 'renter:%') AS "Renter-side failures",
       max(event_time) AS "Last failure",
       (array_agg(cause ORDER BY event_time DESC))[1] AS "Last cause"
FROM (SELECT event_time, executor_id, CASE
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%default command exiting right after start%' THEN 'renter: image exits at start'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%docker_build%' OR details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%build_timeout%' THEN 'renter: image build'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%cancelled_by_delete%' THEN 'renter: deleted while starting'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%no executor accepted the SSH key%' OR details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%submit SSH key%' THEN 'node: SSH key rejected'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%Invalid executor id%' OR details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%offline%' THEN 'node: offline'
    WHEN details ->> 'error_message' ILIKE '%Executor unreachable%' THEN 'node: unreachable'
    WHEN substring(details ->> 'error_message' from 'failure_step: ([a-z_]+)') IS NOT NULL THEN 'node: ' || substring(details ->> 'error_message' from 'failure_step: ([a-z_]+)')
    ELSE 'node: other'
  END AS cause
  FROM executor_events WHERE event_type = 'deploy_failed' AND event_time > now() - interval '1 day') f
GROUP BY executor_id ORDER BY 2 DESC, 4 DESC LIMIT 200
